heading: Forums
intro: Categories hold forums, and a forum can hold subforums: two levels below a category, no more. Give each one a name in every interface language. Pinned categories come first on the forum index, in the order you set; the rest follow by their latest post. Every change is in the audit log.
positionHint: Lower numbers come first among its neighbours.
pinCategory: Pin it to the top of the forum index
reasonHint: For the audit log. Only an empty forum can be removed.
empty: There are no forums yet. Add a category to start.

problems.format: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, 2 to 60 characters.
problems.taken: Another forum already uses this address.
problems.too_deep: A subforum can't hold forums. Pick a category or a forum.
problems.has_children: Move or remove the forums inside it first.
problems.not_category: Only a category can be pinned.

outcomes.saved: Saved. The forum index shows it now.
outcomes.removed: Removed. It has left the forum index.

failures.not_allowed: Only the owner and admins can change the forums.
failures.not_found: That forum no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
failures.unreachable: We couldn't reach the server. Try again.
